title: Reword the receipt page
summary: The receipt page says 'Thank you for your order' in place of 'Order complete'.

collectorItems.title: Should the receipt page keep the old wording for gift orders?
collectorItems.why: What a gift buyer reads on their receipt is a promise about how the shop talks to customers, and only you can decide that tone.
collectorItems.context: The new wording thanks the buyer, but a gift order's receipt goes to the buyer and the new text reads oddly there. This is decision item 1435 on your list, and it is answered here.

options.label: Use the new wording everywhere
options.consequence: Gift buyers read the thank-you line too; one wording to keep.

options.label: Keep the old wording for gift orders
options.consequence: Gift receipts stay as they are; the PR keeps a second wording to maintain.

options.label: Hold the PR until gift orders are reworded
options.consequence: The PR goes back and returns with a new sheet once gift receipts are settled.

collectorItems.ifLeft: The new wording ships on gift receipts as well.

recommendation.reason: One wording is cheaper to keep, and gift buyers are still thanked for their order.

collectorItems.title: Should the receipt page show the order total in the thank-you line?
collectorItems.why: Showing money on a page a customer may share is a privacy call about your customers, and only you can make it.
collectorItems.context: A designer proposed adding the total to the thank-you line. The review found no rule against it and no rule for it.

options.label: Leave the total out
options.consequence: The thank-you line stays short and shows no money.

options.label: Add the total in a follow-up
options.consequence: This ships without the total; a follow-up adds it if you want it.

options.label: Add the total before merge
options.consequence: The PR goes back to add the total and returns with a new sheet.

collectorItems.ifLeft: The thank-you line ships without the total.

recommendation.reason: A receipt that is shared would show what the customer paid.
